as_told.title: Disappearance of Jacobo Grinberg after lattice discovery

plain: The Mexican neurophysiologist and psychologist Jacobo Grinberg vanished in Mexico in the mid-1990s and was never found. An unnamed researcher tells Michels it happened in 1995, "less than a month after Puharich dies," meaning Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychics. This guest cites a documentary film about Grinberg and a person named Ida. Michels tells it himself on two other episodes and dates it to 1994 instead. In one, crediting Alex Gomez-Marin, he says Grinberg's last note was about how he had "figured it out." In the other he says Grinberg vanished just after his biggest discovery, a lattice idea, and does not tie it to Puharich. The tellers disagree on the year and on what the disappearance connects to, but they tell it because, if true, a scientist went missing just as he reached something important.
